platform.environment: Docker in a dedicated Colima VZ virtual machine on macOS arm64

limitations: One patch observation, not a latency guarantee or percentile estimate.
Measured inside a virtual machine with a host-mounted source/build directory, not a bare-metal Linux desktop.
Source capture included; watcher polling and debounce excluded because the acceptance probe invokes the supervisor directly.
Compiler invocation includes dx launch, Rust compilation/linking and captured input/output transport.
Application acknowledgement includes protocol transport and UI dispatch.
Compositor completion under Xvfb is not physical display scan-out.
This record covers the successful combined patch; it does not attest to the subsequent restart acceptance steps.
